text:
Alex - Account Exec: Quick heads-up — Polaris Bank POC kicks off tomorrow. They're asking for a compact checklist on enterprise auth: SSO (SAML) for multiple IdPs, SCIM provisioning (groups + manager attribute), RBAC mapping (groups -> roles), domain ownership verification, and any Dedicated/Private pricing considerations we should surface. Can SEs + security chime in with what to send them before the kickoff?
Priya - Sales Eng: Happy to help. Which IdPs are they using? Azure AD? Okta?
Alex - Account Exec: Pilot will run with Azure AD and Okta (two separate business units). They want users + groups provisioned, and manager attribute populated if available. Also asked about SCIM rate limits for large orgs and whether we support group nesting.
Marcus - Solutions Eng: We support SAML 2.0 and multiple IdP configs per org. SCIM v2 with groups and members supported; nested groups isn't first-class but we can flatten on sync. Hosted defaults: ~10 req/s per tenant (burstable); for Dedicated/Private we can raise/disable limits and do backfill jobs. For groups->roles mapping you can configure attribute mappings in the Console (Org > SSO > Attribute mappings). Example mapping snippet:
```
{
  "saml_attribute": "groups",
  "mappings": [
    {"value":"polaris-admins","role":"admin"},
    {"value":"polaris-read","role":"viewer"}
  ]
}
```
Priya - Sales Eng: Also note we sign SAML requests and expect signed assertions from the IdP.
Jing - Product PM: Timeline notes: domain verification (DNS TXT) is manual and can add 24-48h if IT doesn't have DNS access. Full SCIM initial sync for ~50k users can take ~20-40 minutes depending on attributes; incremental syncs are near-real-time. If they want manager relationships for org chart features, include manager and managerId in attribute mapping.
Sam - Security: They'll ask security questionnaire items: SOC2 Type II report (we have one), ISO27001 (if applicable), KMS/CMK options (customer-managed keys supported for Private/Dedicated integrations), audit logs retention (we can extend on request), and support for SCIM over TLS + signed SAML assertions. For hosted POC we can't provide HSM-backed KMS, but Dedicated/Private can.
Tara - Customer Success: I'll own the SSO/SCIM test plan and runbook for the POC. Can someone paste minimal SAML metadata we can hand to their IdP? Also, pricing: for POC we usually offer trial credits; ballpark Dedicated pricing for small reserve is ~$8k/mo (depends on GPUs/throughput) and Private/or on-prem has setup + infra costs. We'll confirm exact numbers in the quote.
Priya - Sales Eng: Minimal SAML metadata (xml snippet) below for IdP team:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://polaris-poc.redwood.ai">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true" WantAssertionsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://polaris-poc.redwood.ai/saml/acs"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Alex - Account Exec: Perfect — can we consolidate into one checklist doc + pre-kickoff email with links to docs (https://docs.redwood.ai/sso, https://docs.redwood.ai/scim) and send to Polaris IT? Also need to know who on legal should handle their Data Processing Addendum if they request data residency.
Marcus - Solutions Eng: I'll put together a short runbook and configuration checklist and drop it into the Polaris folder tonight, then ping here tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Reminder: POC workspace created for polaris-poc by @Tara at 1750001200 — credentials and console link sent privately.
Tara - Customer Success: I'll draft the email and attach the runbook. Sam/Marcus/Priya please review before I send. Thanks everyone!
